$comment: The event streams an extension can subscribe to (cmux.events.on, cmux.live). An event is an invalidation with no payload: the app reads again. The daemon delivers <family>.changed only to an app that may call <family>.list or <family>.get (apps/subscriptions.rs stream_readable), so `reads` names that op and its scope is the stream's scope. tools/gen-cmux-global.ts checks each `reads` against the catalog and writes the SDKs' table (cmux-extension-sdk/api.json); cmux-tui-core's routing tests check that every stream the daemon publishes is listed here.

workspace.changed.docs: A workspace was created, closed, renamed, reordered, selected or restyled.

pane.changed.docs: A pane was split, closed, resized or focused.

tab.changed.docs: A tab was opened, closed, moved or selected.

terminal.changed.docs: A terminal started, ended or changed its title or folder.

agent.changed.docs: An agent's state changed (working, blocked, idle, done).

agent_chat.changed.docs: An agent chat was added, closed, renamed, read or changed state.
